guarantees.title: What the software guarantees
guarantees.numbering: Every order gets the next fiscal number in the same step as its creation. A cancelled order keeps its number; numbers are never reused or skipped. The number is printed on the receipt.
guarantees.journal: Every sale, change, cancellation, payment and refund is written to a journal where each entry is sealed with the fingerprint of the previous one (SHA-256). Changing or deleting a single entry breaks the chain, and the check above shows it.
guarantees.noDelete: Orders can be cancelled but never deleted. A removed line stays in the journal and in an archive table. Corrections are new entries (refund, cancellation), never overwrites.
guarantees.retention: Nothing is purged automatically. Export a yearly archive and keep it with your accounting documents.
guarantees.limitsTitle: What it cannot do on its own
guarantees.limits: It cannot stop someone from replacing the whole database file or restoring an old backup, and it relies on the PC's clock. Keep backups and the exported archives, and run the check regularly. Customer phone numbers and notes are not frozen in the journal.
guarantees.numberingShort: Gapless ticket numbers, printed on receipts
guarantees.journalShort: Every change sealed in a SHA-256 chain
guarantees.noDeleteShort: Nothing is deleted — only cancelled or refunded
